name: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
summary:
AWARD-WINNING GAME DEVELOPER Denki teams up with the loveable duo, following its creation of Wallace & Gromit: “Curse of the Were-Rabbit” for Sky Gamestar.

Based on the eagerly anticipated Feature Film, the fast-paced, action packed fun takes place in Wallace & Gromit’s own neighbourhood - where an army of Veg-Ravaging-Rabbits run amok destroying the inhabitants’ extremely valuable Prize Vegetables.

Players control everyone's favourite pooch, Gromit, on a mission to clean the neighbourhood of these rampaging rabbits. Armed with an ever increasing array of Wallace’s Cracking Contraptions, Gromit must strive to keep each neighbour happy and their prize veg safe.

But in the midst of all this mayhem, Wallace & Gromit discover another problem to deal with. A problem so large, so monstrous and so very ravenous - a terrifying beast the locals come to call - The Were-Rabbit!

Wallace and Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit is exclusive to the Sky Active games channel.
